scope: Source audit and local read-only credential check. No candidate configuration, billing, or provider resource was changed.

copernicus_worker_secret_routing.finding: The isolated remote-sensing worker filters legacy global COPERNICUS_EMAIL/PASSWORD values, while Coolify's SOPS service-secret installer mapped only the password and left the scoped email/client identifier out of the worker's private env file.
copernicus_worker_secret_routing.resolution: The Coolify secret inventory now treats the scoped Copernicus email and client ID as worker-private values. The installer maps legacy SOPS email, password, client ID, and client secret keys to the corresponding KOKONUT_REMOTE_SENSING_COPERNICUS_* worker keys. The child-environment contract carries only those prefixed values for the remote-sensing worker; global Copernicus values remain filtered.
copernicus_worker_secret_routing.candidate_status: Source is fixed; candidate deployment and live provider authentication through the isolated worker remain unverified.
